release.notes: New: battery health card (local summary of saved battery measurements), history restore from an evDash ZIP, drive replay "Map & graph" and "Compare two drives", redesigned main tiles, green app icon, live traffic on navigation maps, ABRP upload status. Vehicles: Dacia Spring 24.3 LFP and Deepal S07 EREV (preliminary), Mini J01 and MG4 Urban 54 SoC fixes, Tesla 3/Y pack energy fix and odometer. Experimental "Vehicle cloud" (DEV) in the Service menu.
